gary_2026_08_18_tech_x_market_decoders.title: Tech x Market Decoders
gary_2026_08_18_tech_x_market_decoders.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_08_18_tech_x_market_decoders.summary: Gary's Guide: We decode tech & market signals together - so you can operate, invest, & decide better. AI can build a financial model, summarize an earnings call, or map a competitive landscape in seconds. What it can't do is connect the dots around a a technology, a trend, a business, an idea, a decision. That takes human judgment, experience, & taste. The kind you only build by studying real examples, arguing them out loud, & testing your read against people who see it differently than you do. That's what Tech x Market Decoders is for. Every week, we pick one topic - a company or startup everyone's talking about, a technology reshaping an industry, or a shift in how things are being built or bought. Bring your laptop. Here's how it works: 15-20 minutes - decode solo. Quiet research time. Dig into the news, the product, the tech stack, the data. No talking, just thinking. 35-40 minutes - decode together. We open the floor. What did you find? Where do you disagree? What's convincing, what's overhyped, what would change your mind? This is where judgment actually gets built - not from reading alone, but from testing your read against someone else's. Last few minutes - wrap up. You'll leave with a sharper read on the topic than you walked in with, & a few new perspectives you hadn't considered. That's the whole point. This week's topic: Situational Awareness. Are we in an AI bubble? Circular financing between AI labs & infrastructure players, record market concentration, & capex spending that's outpacing monetization. We're decoding the real risk signals versus the noise, & what it means for how you invest from here. Come as you are - operator, investor, builder, or just someone who reads too much tech or business news & wants to discuss with smart people. About Us This event is organized by Innovest, a media-led intelligence platform at the intersection of tech & markets, built for operators, investors, & founders. Through newsletters, a growing library of business models, & events like this one, we're building the judgment, experience, & taste that no AI can replace - one pattern, one playbook, one signal at a time. Disclaimer By registering for this event, you'll be added to the Innovest newsletter (innovest.substack.com). You can unsubscribe at any time.

gary_2026_08_18_claude_code_workshop.title: Claude Code Workshop
gary_2026_08_18_claude_code_workshop.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_08_18_claude_code_workshop.summary: Gary's Guide: Learn to orchestrate AI agents that write & ship code for you. Claude Code is already changing how the best engineering teams ship. This workshop, presented with Provectus, is a chance to build with it directly - not watch a demo, not sit through slides about it. You'll leave having shipped something real, with a working sense of how to bring this back to your own team. We'll spend a little time on context - how Claude Code fits into modern engineering workflows & where teams are seeing the biggest wins. Then the slides go away, & you're at a build station with Anthropic engineers & Provectus partners beside you, orchestrating agents that write & ship code while you direct the work. Why attend Ship real output. Your agents write the code - you direct them. You'll leave with something you actually built, not a slide deck about what's possible. See best practices in action. Learn how Claude Code fits into enterprise workflows, from the people who deploy it at scale. Get direct support. Live help at every table from Anthropic engineers & Provectus partners - no one gets stuck on an error alone. Build your network. Spend the afternoon with technical leaders wrestling with the same questions you are. Who should attend Engineering Leaders - EMs, VPs, CTOs, Platform Leads, Principal Engineers Business Leaders - CPOs, Digital Transformation, senior AI sponsors, PMs You don't need to be an engineer. If you're making decisions about AI investment or setting strategy, understanding what Claude Code actually does is the edge. Agenda 1:00 PM - 2:30 PM: Registration & setup support 2:30 PM - 3:00 PM: Welcome, Claude Code overview, demo 3:00 PM - 5:00 PM: Build session: hands-on with Claude Code 4 PM - 5 PM: Networking Happy Hour What to bring Your laptop - Basic comfort with a terminal or code editor is helpful but not required - you'll be directing AI agents & building alongside them, & our team supports you the whole way. The fine print The event is free to attend if selected. Registration is required & subject to approval. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis - apply early. Want to bring a colleague? Have them apply separately - every seat needs its own approved registration.

gary_2026_08_20_stronger_together_find_y.summary: Gary's Guide: Stronger Together: Find Your Co-Founder Building an AI startup is hard. Building it with the right co-founder changes everything. Whether you're a technical builder looking for a commercial partner, a product leader searching for an AI engineer, or an operator with a big vision looking for someone equally obsessed with bringing it to life, this event is designed to help you meet the right people through structured, high-quality conversations. Goodbye to headless networking! Unlike traditional meetups where everyone drifts from conversation to conversation, this evening is designed around intentional matching, giving you multiple opportunities to connect with people who complement your skills, ambitions, & interests. What to expect Opening Keynote A short talk on what makes exceptional founding teams, common mistakes when choosing co-founders, & how to evaluate long-term fit beyond technical skills. 60-Second Founder Introductions Every attendee will have the opportunity to introduce themselves in one minute (subject to capacity). Tell the room: Who you are What you're building (or want to build) What you're looking for What you can bring to a founding team Each attendee will also receive a name tag highlighting their background, interests, & expertise to make conversations easier. Facilitated Co-Founder Matching Instead of random networking, attendees will rotate between themed discussion tables based on startup stage, industry, technologies, or interests. These small-group conversations are designed to help you quickly discover complementary skills, shared vision, & potential collaboration opportunities. Community Mixer Continue conversations & meet other founders, investors, operators, & builders in the community. Who should attend AI founders looking for a co-founder Engineers interested in starting a company Product managers & designers passionate about AI GTM, sales, & growth leaders looking to join an early-stage startup Researchers & technical builders exploring startup ideas Experienced operators interested in becoming founding team members Who this event is for We're curating for ambitious, execution-oriented people who are serious about building companies. You don't need to have a startup today, but you should have the skills, experience, or commitment to become part of a founding team. Whether you already have an idea or are looking for the right person to build one with, you'll leave having met people who could become your future co-founder. Space is limited, & applications may be reviewed to maintain a high-quality mix of attendees. The Yard: The Yard is a coworking space at the intersection of creativity, design, & play with locations in Manhattan, Brooklyn, Philly, Washington DC, & Chicago, with a variety of shared & private workspace options to meet your team's needs. Built to inspire & cultivate success, The Yard is here to help you win! Learn more at theyard.com. About Pioneering Minds AI: At pioneeringminds.ai, we grow AI native pioneers who build, deploy, & govern AI responsibly & put humans at the front seat. We help YOU - our AI pioneers - to truly understand AI & create real value out of AI. Our mission is straightforward: Accelerate Innovation: Equip participants with cutting-edge AI tools to deliver rapid prototypes. Foster Collaboration: Unite diverse teams-students, engineers, & civic leaders-to tackle urban challenges head-on. Create Lasting Impact: Offer continued mentorship & post-event partnerships so promising concepts can scale beyond the weekend.

gary_2026_08_22_dell_x_nvidia_hackathon_.summary: Gary's Guide: Dell x NVIDIA's Local AI on Dell Pro Max with GB10 is a oneday build sprint where you ship an alwayson business agent running locally on the Dell Pro Max with GB10. A one-day hackathon. Real hardware on the line. 40 teams. 40 Dell Pro Max with GB10 units. One day to build an AI agent that runs locally on the box (no cloud API) & helps businesses or corporates. You get the hardware. You get the stack. You get a day to ship something real. Prizes - 1st place takes home a Dell Pro Max with GB10p per team. - 2nd & 3rd win a Dell laptop per team. ---- Your AI model on a drive. Venue Wi-Fi won't be fast enough for everyone to download models on the day, so load anything you want to use onto a USB or external drive ahead of time. A laptop for development. You'll get a Dell Pro Max with GB10 for the day, but bring your own laptop to code on. Your demo has to run locally on the box. A power strip or extension. We won't have one outlet per person, so if your battery's weak, a splitter or extension cord is a smart backup. Sign up here or sign up at the main event page & hackathon platform - BuilderBase https://builderbase.com/event/dell-x-nvidia-ai-hackathon-nyc How it works 01 Apply Fill out the application form on this page. We review on a rolling basis & confirm your spot by email. 02 Team formation Teams of 2-4 builders. If you register alone, use the BuilderBase dashboard to find teammates or we'll pair you before the event. 03 Build Show up on August 22th. You get a Dell Pro Max with GB10 for the day. Build an AI agent that runs locally on the box. Business or corporate use cases, required stack: OpenClaw + NVIDIA NemoClaw + OpenShell. 04 Submit Submit your working demo through the BuilderBase portal before the deadline. Demo must run on the Dell Pro Max with GB10. 05 Live pitch Top 8 teams are selected from all submissions & deliver a short live pitch to the judges the same evening. 06 Win 07 Mingle/Networking 1st place takes home a Dell Pro Max with GB10p per team. 2nd & 3rd win a Dell laptop per team. Sign up here!

gary_2026_08_25_tech_x_market_decoders_t.title: Tech x Market Decoders (This week's topic - Anthropic's IPO)
gary_2026_08_25_tech_x_market_decoders_t.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_08_25_tech_x_market_decoders_t.summary: Gary's Guide: We decode tech & market signals together - so you can operate, invest, & decide better. AI can build a financial model, summarize an earnings call, or map a competitive landscape in seconds. What it can't do is connect the dots around a technology, a trend, a business, an idea, a decision. That takes human judgment, experience, & taste. The kind you only build by studying real examples, arguing them out loud, & testing your read against people who see it differently than you do. That's what Tech x Market Decoders is for. Every week, we pick one topic - a company or startup everyone's talking about, a technology reshaping an industry, or a shift in how things are being built or bought. Bring your laptop. Here's how it works: 15-20 minutes - decode solo. Quiet research time. Dig into the news, the product, the tech stack, the data. No talking, just thinking. 35-40 minutes - decode together. We open the floor. What did you find? Where do you disagree? What's convincing, what's overhyped, what would change your mind? This is where judgment actually gets built - not from reading alone, but from testing your read against someone else's. Last few minutes - wrap up. This week's topic: Anthropic's upcoming IPO Anthropic filed confidentially for one of the most anticipated debuts in years, with a listing expected in Sept/Oct 2026. We're decoding the business behind Claude; the revenue growth, the compute costs, & whether the valuation actually holds up once Wall Street gets a look. Come as you are - operator, investor, builder, or just someone who reads too much tech or business news & wants to discuss with smart people.

gary_2026_08_26_hard_negatives_ai_enggrs.summary: Gary's Guide: Join the AI debate night where you defend the take you'd never post online. RAG is dead. AI is already sentient. Not feeling argumentative? Come watch the debates, play games, grab a drink, & enjoy the spectacle from a safe distance. Your RSVP includes: one drink ticket (beer, wine, classic cocktail or well drink) for the first 150 people to arrive Small bites & appetizers Unlimited pool tables, darts, foosball , ping pong & shuffleboard tables Built for engineers, AI researchers, & builders in New York City, especially anyone working on search, retrieval, or agents. By registering, you agree to receive event emails & consent to being photographed at the event.

jc_culture_42565_2026_08_19_true_colors_.title: True Colors, Carried On: A Pride Gathering on Grief and Legacy
jc_culture_42565_2026_08_19_true_colors_.label: Art / Culture
jc_culture_42565_2026_08_19_true_colors_.place: Pet Shop, 193 Newark Ave, Jersey City, NJ
jc_culture_42565_2026_08_19_true_colors_.summary: This Pride, what if our true colors included the ones we’ve lost? True Colors, Carried On is an evening of small-group, facilitated conversation about dying, grief, and the legacies we leave behind, held in Jersey City during Pride Month. This isn’t therapy, it’s community and permission to say the word “death” out loud during a month that’s usually about celebration, because both things can be true at once. Consider bringing a photo or small keepsake of someone you’re carrying. If you don’t have one on hand, we’ll have materials for you to write out a memory or decorate a name tag when you arrive.

jc_culture_43077_2026_08_19_battle_of_pa.title: BATTLE OF PAULUS HOOK AMERICA 250 PROCESSION
jc_culture_43077_2026_08_19_battle_of_pa.label: Parks / Outdoor
jc_culture_43077_2026_08_19_battle_of_pa.place: Washington & Dudley Streets, Washington & Dudley Streets, Jersey City, New Jersey
jc_culture_43077_2026_08_19_battle_of_pa.summary: The Battle of Paulus Hook was a daring surprise nighttime raid fought on August 19, 1779, during the American Revolutionary War. Major Henry “Light Horse Harry” Lee led a force of Continental Army soldiers against the British-held fort on the Paulus Hook peninsula in modern-day downtown Jersey City. The patriots successfully captured 158 prisoners, boosting American morale. Join the Fife & Drum Procession at Washington and Dudley Streets as they march up to Paulus Hook Park. After the procession, stay to for a lively presentation of local history, performed by local actors.

jc_culture_10003567_2026_09_09_hamilton_.title: Hamilton Park Farmers Market 2026
jc_culture_10003567_2026_09_09_hamilton_.label: Festival / Market
jc_culture_10003567_2026_09_09_hamilton_.place: Hamilton Park, 9 McWilliams Pl., Jersey City, NJ
jc_culture_10003567_2026_09_09_hamilton_.summary: Join us at the Hamilton Park Farmers Market, your midweek destination for fresh, local, and thoughtfully crafted food and goods. Each week, we’re proud to feature farm-fresh produce from Stony Hill Farm alongside a curated selection of specialty vendors. Browse a variety of offerings including our long time vendor Pickles and Olives, fresh seafood from Scale Fish Market, and prepared foods perfect for dinner. You can also find baked goods, candles, personal care products, and more. You can even take advantage of convenient services like on-site knife sharpening while you shop. On the first and second Wednesdays of each month, enjoy live entertainment that adds to the vibrant, community atmosphere of the market. Whether you’re shopping for the week, grabbing a bite, or simply enjoying the park, the Hamilton Park Farmers Market is a welcoming space to connect with local vendors and neighbors.

jc_culture_10004817_2026_09_11_the_socie.title: The Society of American Graphic Artists (SAGA) 91st Annual Members Exhibition 2026
jc_culture_10004817_2026_09_11_the_socie.label: Art / Culture
jc_culture_10004817_2026_09_11_the_socie.place: MANA CONTEMPORARY, 888 NEWARK AVE., JERSEY CITY
jc_culture_10004817_2026_09_11_the_socie.summary: 91st Annual Members Exhibition The Society of American Graphic Artists (SAGA) is excited to announce its upcoming 91st Annual Members Exhibition, to be held at Mana Contemporary in Jersey City from September 11–27, 2026 (Fridays and Saturdays, 3:00–7:00 PM; Sundays, 12:00–3:00 PM). The exhibition will feature 200 hand-pulled prints representing a broad range of printmaking techniques and subjects, created by SAGA artists from across the country. Awards will be juried by Leslie Diuguid, founder of Du-Good Press in Brooklyn. The Society of American Graphic Artists (SAGA) is a nonprofit organization established in 1915 whose mission is to promote contemporary printmakers, cultivate printmaking appreciation and education, and provide a collaborative and inclusive platform for artists across the country. https://sagaprints.com/ Hosting this year’s exhibition is Monira Foundation, an independent nonprofit institution that functions as a radical experimental laboratory, working in close collaboration with artists, curators, musicians, dancers, producers, and writers to conceive, realize, and present innovative projects in all media. Monira is located within Mana Contemporary, a 2-million-square-foot art center. The complex occupies a renovated 100-year-old former tobacco warehouse, featuring expansive exhibition spaces, working artist studios, the International Center of Photography archives, and more. A free public reception and awards ceremony with participating artists will be held on Saturday, September 26, from 3:00–5:00 PM. Guests are invited to enjoy light refreshments while celebrating the diversity and innovation of contemporary printmaking. WHEN Exhibition: Fridays–Sundays, September 11–27, 2026 Public Reception & Awards Ceremony: Saturday, September 26, 2026 3:00–5:00 PM WHERE Mana Contemporary 888 Newark Avenue Jersey City, NJ 07306
